title: HTX Adventure Park Admission – ATV Rental Fee Not Included
includes: Admission Fees are for park access only
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: For anyone looking to experience the thrill of off-road adventures, our ATV rental company stands unrivaled as the #1 choice in Houston, Texas! With a variety of scenic routes and terrains to explore, we guarantee an unforgettable adventure that caters to every level of experience. Whether you're seeking a solo ride, a family outing, or a group expedition, we are the perfect fit for you! Ride ATV’s with us and then jump on our Large Inflatable Water Obstacle Course or visit the animals in our petting zoo!
